title: A larger hydrogen orbit model
hook: Change principal quantum number and predict Bohr orbit radius.
misconception: Bohr orbit radius doubles when principal quantum number doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply r_n = a₀n² to compare Bohr orbit radius when principal quantum number changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With the nonrelativistic Bohr model of hydrogen with allowed positive integer levels, r_n = a₀n². When principal quantum number doubles, Bohr orbit radius becomes 4 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model r_n = a₀n²; scaling exponent 2. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider the nonrelativistic Bohr model of hydrogen with allowed positive integer levels, with a nonzero initial result. If principal quantum number triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on Bohr orbit radius?
recall.why: Apply r_n = a₀n² under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 9.
